units.source_text: 于是，突然库拉巴喀站了起来，狠狠的把塔那格拉偶人摔倒了地上。

en.t: Then, all at once, Kurabaka stood up and violently hurled the Tanagra doll down onto the floor.

units.source_text: 拉卟可能非常害怕，不知喊了声什么，抬起腿想跑。

en.t: Rapp must have been terribly frightened; he cried out something and lifted his leg to run away.

units.source_text: 库拉巴喀向拉卟和我做了个 “别害怕”的手势，

en.t: Kurabaka made a gesture to Rapp and me that meant, Do not be afraid,

units.source_text: 镇静自若地说道：“这是因为你也跟俗人一样耳朵是个摆设。

en.t: and said with perfect composure, That is because your ears, like those of ordinary people, are only ornaments.
What I am afraid of is Loka...
